editorial_note: Indian Bengali mixed number is rendered মিশ্র ভগ্নাংশ, witnessed in SCERT Tripura p.50; this is a supplementary Indian Bengali witness, not a claim of West Bengal teacher validation. Whole number is অঋণাত্মক পূর্ণসংখ্যা to preserve its distinction from integer. In fs-idm267178704 the English alt incorrectly describes 8/8 plus 3/8; the actual pinned image 075 has seven sectors per circle and two shaded in the second circle, consistent with source problem 9/7 and answer 1 2/7. Bengali alt corrects only that descriptive error; the image and mathematical answer are unchanged. The integrating parent authorized three explicit linguistic mtext translations in fs-id1152212; all mathematical tokens and structure remain unchanged and the inverse replacement must restore exact original MathML. The source's proper/improper classification is retained in its positive-fraction teaching context, not generalized here to signed rational numbers.

source_errata.issue: Mixed-number definition calls its fractional part merely a fraction.
source_errata.resolution: Explicitly says proper fraction within the positive mixed-number model, supported by actual TR01 p50 and the source worked examples; preserves source MathML and nonzero denominator conditions.
